name: Nearest Voxel Lookup with Periodic Boundary
definition: Retrieves voxel values at the nearest integer grid coordinates for a set of normalized sample points, handling out-of-bounds indices by wrapping them using modulo arithmetic (periodic boundary conditions).
summary: Nearest Voxel Lookup with Periodic Boundary retrieves a single voxel's density without interpolation, using modulo arithmetic to wrap out-of-bounds coordinates for seamless tiling.
